item.title: Irish public sector trade unions suspend second day of strikes
item.description: Irish public sector trade unions suspended a second day of widespread strikes planned for next week after they agreed on Friday to begin mediated discussions with the government this weekend on the terms for new pay talks.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Irish public sector trade unions suspended a second day of widespread strikes planned for next week after they agreed on Friday to begin mediated discussions with the government this weekend on the terms for new pay talks. Much of Ireland's public sector including teachers, health workers and civil servants on Wednesday staged the country's [USN:L1N4600B0 TEXT:"first major strike"] in almost two decades after failing for months to agree with ministers on the basis for negotiations on pay rises. The two sides agreed on Friday to begin a process aimed at finding a basis for formal negotiations to commence. "I believe that there is now a prospect of progress in the process that has been established. Obviously we will need to see the government's words backed up in practice," Kevin Callinan, chair of the Irish Congress of Trade Unions public services committee, told national broadcaster RTE.

item.title: Novartis ends mid-stage Fabhalta trial targeting serious kidney condition
item.description: Swiss drugmaker Novartis has terminated a mid-stage study testing its drug Fabhalta in patients with a serious kidney condition, citing "strategic considerations", according to a federal clinical trials registry.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Swiss drugmaker Novartis (NOVN.S) has terminated a mid-stage study testing its drug Fabhalta in patients with a serious kidney condition, citing "strategic considerations", according to a federal clinical trials registry. The trial was evaluating whether the oral medication was safe and effective for treating lupus nephritis when added to standard medical care Lupus nephritis is a severe inflammation of the kidneys caused by the autoimmune disease lupus The government database, last updated on October 15, shows Novartis decided to conclude the study after completing the first part It gives no other explanation and does not say whether safety or effectiveness played a role Endpoints News reported the development earlier on Friday Novartis did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment The US FDA first approved Fabhalta in 2023 for a rare blood disorder called PNH. It has since been approved for two kidney diseases, IgA nephropathy and C3 glomerulopathy

item.title: Enviado de Putin diz que Rússia e EUA discutem acordos conjuntos, incluindo data centres
item.description: Rússia e EUA estão discutindo uma série de novos projetos conjuntos, incluindo data centres movidos a energia nuclear, na esteira do acordo sobre diesel firmado na semana passada, disse nesta sexta-feira o enviado para investimentos do presidente Vladimir Putin.
item.dc:creator: Vladimir Soldatkin, Olesya Astakhova
item.content:encoded: Rússia e EUA estão discutindo uma série de novos projetos conjuntos, incluindo data centres movidos a energia nuclear, na esteira do acordo sobre diesel firmado na semana passada, disse nesta sexta-feira o enviado para investimentos do presidente Vladimir Putin. Kirill Dmitriev afirmou que as sanções dos EUA representam sérios obstáculos e criticou como “equivocada” a Lei Graham, assinada pelo presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, no mês passado, que visa reduzir as receitas energéticas da Rússia por meio de sanções e tarifas. No entanto, ele disse que os dois países estão considerando outras formas de cooperação econômica na esteira do acordo sobre o diesel. “Também estamos discutindo projetos conjuntos na área de data centres russos e norte-americanos, inclusive com o uso de usinas nucleares de pequena escala”, acrescentou ele, sem dar detalhes. Neste mês, a Ucrânia atacou centros de dados do grupo de tecnologia russo Yandex e do grupo bancário e tecnológico Sberbank, no que classificou como uma resposta a ataques russos contra instalações ucranianas. Dmitriev, figura-chave nas negociações entre a Rússia e os EUA para pôr fim à guerra na Ucrânia, vem há muito tempo pressionando por uma série de acordos potenciais ambiciosos, inclusive sobre minerais e energia. O Kremlin tem manifestado frustração pelo fato de os EUA, até agora, terem vinculado tais acordos a um acordo de paz, que continua indefinido. Mas Dmitriev demonstrou otimismo de que isso está mudando. “Naturalmente, o progresso é bastante difícil; há resistência — resistência generalizada, na verdade — de vários setores. No entanto, como demonstra o exemplo do diesel, acredito que em breve anunciaremos várias outras iniciativas significativas. O gelo, de fato, começou a se quebrar”, disse ele na conferência Russian Energy Week, em Moscou. “Estamos efetivamente implementando projetos com os Estados Unidos da América neste exato momento e continuaremos a fazê-lo até que a operação militar especial chegue ao fim”, acrescentou ele, usando o termo do Kremlin para se referir à guerra. Dmitriev disse que o Tesouro dos EUA havia solicitado ao fundo soberano da Rússia, que ele dirige, que ajudasse a resolver questões complexas de pagamento relacionadas ao acordo sobre o diesel. O acordo anunciado por Trump há uma semana envolve o fornecimento de diesel russo aos mercados dos EUA e globais, a fim de reduzir o preço do combustível — uma prioridade para o presidente dos EUA antes das eleições de meio de mandato do próximo mês.

item.title: Swiss finance minister warns steep European debt could trigger euro crisis
item.description: Rising public debt levels in Europe and beyond pose a risk to economic stability and could trigger a euro crisis, Swiss Finance Minister Karin Keller-Sutter said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Rising public debt levels in Europe and beyond pose a risk to economic stability and could trigger a euro crisis, Swiss Finance Minister Karin Keller-Sutter said on Friday. Speaking to Swiss national broadcaster SRF in Bangkok on the sidelines of the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank, Keller-Sutter said energy prices were also fuelling concerns among policymakers. Switzerland has one of the lowest levels of public debt in Europe, but Keller-Sutter said it was important to see the bigger picture in the current environment. "We're so deeply interconnected internationally that we're also vulnerable, for instance, in case a debt crisis arises due to the sovereign debt of major countries. "I'm thinking in particular of the United States, but also of Europe; we have France - that could lead to a euro crisis," Keller-Sutter told SRF. France's public debt, budget deficits and tepid economic growth have [USN:L6N45Y0KA TEXT:"fed concern"] about its finances as political fragmentation has complicated fiscal consolidation efforts.

item.title: Trump says neither he nor Musk responsible for Ukraine Starlink access
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that he did not think either he or Elon Musk was responsible for Ukraine losing Starlink access in a way that affected its military operations against Russia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that he did not think either he or Elon Musk was responsible for Ukraine losing Starlink access in a way that affected its military operations against Russia. The reduction in services provided by the satellite company interrupted communications with headquarters and caused internet speeds to drop. Reuters reported on Thursday that the White House approved the [USN:L1N4610ZC TEXT:"reduction in Starshield services"]. Trump, speaking to reporters as he left the White House on a trip to Georgia, said neither he nor Musk was responsible for Ukraine losing Starlink access. Any limit to Ukraine's access to the Starshield system was not imposed by the United States, Trump added. Starshield was developed by SpaceX specifically for government and national-security customers, particularly the US Department of Defense. Starshield uses the Starlink constellation as its backbone. Trump also he has a good relationship with Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskiy.

item.title: Division II DB Tyler Ulrich dies days after in-game injury
item.description: A North Texas community and an Oklahoma college campus are in mourning following the death of defensive back Tyler Ulrich, who died five days after suffering a traumatic injury in a game.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A North Texas community and an Oklahoma college campus are in mourning following the death of defensive back Tyler Ulrich, who died five days after suffering a traumatic injury in a game. Ulrich, from Azle, Texas, was injured in the game between his team, Southern Nazarene, and Ouachita Baptist in Arkadelphia, Ark., last Saturday in an NCAA Division II meeting. The school announced the passing of the sophomore finance major on Thursday. "When I think of good, I think of Tyler Ulrich," Jason Vines, who coached him at Azle High School, told WFAA. "One of the sweetest young men I've ever been around, ever known." Southern Nazarene, based in Bethany, Okla., canceled its game set for this Saturday at Southwestern Oklahoma State. After the 49-14 loss at Ouachita, the university confirmed Ulrich, 21, was in critical condition but never specified the injury. In a statement issued Thursday, Southern Nazarene asked the community to keep Ulrich's family in their thoughts. "This loss is deeply felt across our campus," read a school statement posted to X. "Our hearts are with his family, friends, teammates, and everyone who knew him. We ask that you join us in lifting them up in prayer." In six games for Southern Nazarene this season, Ulrich made 39 tackles. He was in his third season with the Crimson Storm. --Field Level Media

item.title: Djokovic returns to Basel for first time since 2011 in ATP Finals bid
item.description: Novak Djokovic on Friday received a wildcard entry into the Swiss Indoors Basel, setting up his first appearance at the tournament since 2011 as the 24-times Grand Slam champion pursues a place at the ATP Finals and the 103rd title of his career.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Novak Djokovic on Friday received a wildcard entry into the Swiss Indoors Basel, setting up his first appearance at the tournament since 2011 as the 24-times Grand Slam champion pursues a place at the ATP Finals and the 103rd title of his career. The 39-year-old Serbian arrives in Switzerland after a mixed Asian swing, where he captured a [USN:L6N45S0UI TEXT:"record seventh China Open crown"] before suffering a [USN:L1N45V0DT TEXT:"surprise second-round defeat"] by Poland's Hubert Hurkacz at the Shanghai Masters, a tournament he has won a record four times. Djokovic has endured an uneven season by his lofty standards. The former world number one [USN:L4N44R04U TEXT:"exited the US Open"] in the first round, his earliest Grand Slam defeat since the 2006 Australian Open. The decision to add Basel to his schedule comes as something of a surprise after Djokovic said following his early exit in Shanghai that he planned to play only the Paris Masters, scheduled for November 2-8, before the season-ending ATP Finals. Basel offers Djokovic an opportunity to strengthen his bid for a 17th ATP Finals appearance. He sits 11th in the ATP Live Race to Turin and needs to finish inside the top nine, with world number one [USN:L1N45S0CV TEXT:"Jannik Sinner sidelined"] for the remainder of 2026 because of a persistent knee injury. Djokovic will make his fourth appearance in Basel, having lifted the trophy in 2009 by beating Swiss great Roger Federer in the final. He joins a strong field that includes Canadian Felix Auger-Aliassime and Americans Ben Shelton and Taylor Fritz at the ATP 500 indoor hardcourt event, which runs from October 26-November 1.

item.title: Trump says Zacharia should reconsider White House spokeswoman role
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Friday he told new White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia she should reconsider her role after facing public scrutiny a week after taking the job.
item.dc:creator: Trevor Hunnicutt, Jasper Ward
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Friday he told [USN:FWN45V14O TEXT:"new"] White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia she should reconsider her role after facing public scrutiny a week after taking the job. "I told her: 'I think you're better off being happy, and I'm not sure you can ever be happy in this stuff.' There's nothing easy about this stuff," Trump told reporters. He added: "I said to her honestly, 'If I were you, I'd reconsider... think about it. But I would reconsider.'" White House press secretary Katie Zacharia says she did not pass bar exam Fox News, citing a White House official, later reported that Zacharia was "transitioning" out of the role of press secretary.Zacharia held her debut White House briefing on Tuesday. The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Zacharia had said she received a call about the role of press secretary last Wednesday and got offered the job to succeed Karoline Leavitt last Friday. Trump later announced her appointment. In his announcement, he described her an attorney. Over the last week, the issue of whether Zacharia, a graduate of California's Pepperdine University law school, had actually passed the bar - making her an attorney - came [USN:L6N4601D0 TEXT:"under fire"]. On Friday, during a Fox News interview on Thursday, Zacharia said she [USN:L1N46201S TEXT:"did not pass the bar"].Anthony Scaramucci served director of communications for 10 days during Trump's first administration.

item.title: Sheinbaum y Bukele no discutieron públicamente sobre sus sistemas educativos
item.description: La presidenta de México, Claudia Sheinbaum, y el presidente de El Salvador, Nayib Bukele, no discutieron públicamente sobre sus sistemas educativos, contrario a lo que sugieren publicaciones con un video alterado de la mandataria mexicana y un discurso de su homólogo salvadoreño en el que no menciona a México.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: La presidenta de México, Claudia Sheinbaum, y el presidente de El Salvador, Nayib Bukele, no discutieron públicamente sobre sus sistemas educativos, contrario a lo que sugieren publicaciones con un video alterado de la mandataria mexicana y un discurso de su homólogo salvadoreño en el que no menciona a México. Ejemplos en internet dicen que, después de que Bukele anunció en agosto la entrega de 50 mil becas, Sheinbaum declaró en una conferencia que él solo busca un "espectáculo". Según las publicaciones, el presidente salvadoreño le respondió en un evento. Sin embargo, no hay evidencia de que la presidenta hiciera el comentario que se le atribuye. Las imágenes del primer fragmento corresponden a una conferencia de prensa matutina del 24 de agosto y, de acuerdo con el video completo y la versión estenográfica , no hizo referencia a Bukele o a sus iniciativas. No se identificaron declaraciones similares de Sheinbaum en medios de comunicación y en sus cuentas de redes sociales oficiales . El equipo de Comunicación Social de Presidencia de México dijo a Reuters el 13 de octubre en un mensaje de WhatsApp que el contenido es falso. El presidente salvadoreño publicó el segundo fragmento del video en su canal de YouTube el 15 de septiembre. En él, pidió a la ministra de Educación avanzar en mejoras educativas y habló sobre las becas para estudios superiores, no hizo referencia al modelo educativo mexicano o Sheinbaum. La presidencia de El Salvador no respondió inmediatamente a una solicitud de comentarios. Reuters ha abordado otras publicaciones que adjudican comentarios sin sustento a los políticos. VEREDICTO Falso. La presidenta de México, Claudia Sheinbaum, no criticó el programa de becas de Nayib Bukele y su homólogo salvadoreño no respondió a esos cuestionamientos. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: Real Madrid pede saída do presidente da LaLiga após comparação com propaganda nazista
item.description: O Real Madrid pediu nesta sexta-feira a renúncia do presidente da LaLiga, Javier Tebas, depois que ele comparou a retórica da diretoria do clube aos métodos de propaganda utilizados pelo Partido Nazista na Alemanha.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Real Madrid pediu nesta sexta-feira a renúncia do presidente da LaLiga, Javier Tebas, depois que ele comparou a retórica da diretoria do clube aos métodos de propaganda utilizados pelo Partido Nazista na Alemanha. Tebas escreveu na manhã desta sexta-feira nas redes sociais que “a diretoria do Real Madrid conduz uma orquestra de porta-vozes e a Real Madrid TV lidera o coro”. O presidente da LaLiga estava respondendo a artigos de dois jornalistas que afirmavam que ele e a LaLiga estavam agindo contra os interesses do Real. Tebas acrescentou que os autores no jornal El Debate estavam amplificando uma mensagem em nome da diretoria do Real Madrid. A Reuters solicitou um comentário ao El Debate. A demanda do Real Madrid para que Tebas saia imediatamente aprofunda a disputa entre o clube e o presidente da LaLiga. Em setembro, o Real pediu a nomeação de um novo presidente da LaLiga em resposta a Tebas, que classificou as reclamações do clube sobre as decisões de arbitragem como “uma cortina de fumaça” para encobrir suas deficiências em campo. Tebas criticou, na sexta-feira, a cobertura da Real Madrid TV sobre a arbitragem em suas partidas. “O roteiro deles é sempre o mesmo: selecionar as jogadas que lhes convêm, repetir as queixas, alimentar a desconfiança e apontar o dedo para os inimigos”, escreveu ele. “Esse método lembra os mecanismos de propaganda usados por Goebbels, ministro da Propaganda da Alemanha nazista." “A comparação é com essas técnicas de propaganda, não com uma ideologia ou, é claro, com a torcida madridista”, acrescentou o presidente da LaLiga. O Real Madrid divulgou um comunicado na sexta-feira pedindo que Tebas renuncie aos cargos de presidente da LaLiga e vice-presidente da Real Federação Espanhola de Futebol. O comunicado considerou “intolerável e extraordinariamente grave” o fato de Tebas ter usado “uma comparação com os métodos de propaganda do regime nazista para desacreditar nosso clube, sua diretoria e sua emissora de TV”. “A conduta repetida de Tebas demonstra falta de neutralidade, respeito e imparcialidade, incompatível com suas responsabilidades institucionais”, afirmou o Real. “É inaceitável que ele se aproveite até mesmo de perguntas, informações ou opiniões de jornalistas não ligados ao clube para direcionar suas acusações contra nós, atribuindo-nos ações de terceiros pelas quais não temos qualquer responsabilidade.” Tebas, de 64 anos, eleito pelos 42 clubes profissionais das duas principais divisões da Espanha, é presidente da LaLiga desde 2013. Em 2023, ele foi reeleito sem oposição até 2027.

item.title: Ações europeias fecham melhor semana desde junho com balanços amenizando impacto de vendas em tecnologia
item.description: As ações europeias subiram nesta sexta-feira, encerrando sua melhor semana desde o final de junho, com sólidos resultados financeiros ajudando a amenizar o impacto de uma onda global de vendas de ações do setor de tecnologia.
item.dc:creator: Avinash P, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: As ações europeias subiram nesta sexta-feira, encerrando sua melhor semana desde o final de junho, com sólidos resultados financeiros ajudando a amenizar o impacto de uma onda global de vendas de ações do setor de tecnologia. O índice pan-europeu STOXX 600 (.STOXX) subiu 0,7%, para 644,74 pontos, atingindo a maior cotação em mais de três semanas. O índice de referência acumulou alta de mais de 2% na semana. “Esta semana demonstrou o valor da diversificação quando o mercado tecnológico concentrado dos EUA fica sob pressão”, disse Daniela Hathorn, analista sênior de mercado da Capital.com. Uma onda de vendas em ações de empresas de tecnologia de grande destaque, motivada por preocupações com a crescente dependência de dívida para desenvolver infraestrutura de IA, aliada a receios quanto à concorrência da China, prejudicou as ações do setor de tecnologia nesta semana. No entanto, resultados sólidos da fabricante de equipamentos para chips de computador ASML (ASML.AS) , da fornecedora de sistemas de chips Aixtron (AIXGn.DE) e da fabricante de equipamentos de telecomunicações Ericsson (ERICb.ST) ajudaram a melhorar o ânimo do mercado. “Uma temporada de resultados financeiros muito positiva vai realmente impulsionar o ânimo dos investidores. Isso pode levar os mercados de volta a alguns dos picos que vimos recentemente”, disse Michael Field, estrategista-chefe de ações da Morningstar. Espera-se que os lucros das empresas do STOXX 600 aumentem 20,7% no terceiro trimestre em relação ao ano anterior, uma ligeira queda em relação à previsão de crescimento de 21% divulgada na semana passada, segundo dados da LSEG I/B/E/S. O índice pan-europeu STOXX 600 (.STOXX) fechou em alta de 0,67%, a 644,43 pontos. Em LONDRES, o índice Financial Times (.FTSE) avançou 0,38%, a 10.881,90 pontos. Em FRANKFURT, o índice DAX (.GDAXI) subiu 0,94%, a 25.622,42 pontos. Em PARIS, o índice CAC-40 (.FCHI) ganhou 0,28%, a 7.956,70 pontos. Em MILÃO, o índice Ftse/Mib (.FTMIB) teve valorização de 0,93%, a 49.857,18 pontos. Em MADRI, o índice Ibex-35 (.IBEX) registrou alta de 0,77%, a 19.326,30 pontos. Em LISBOA, o índice PSI20 (.PSI20) valorizou-se 1,01%, a 9.468,47 pontos.

item.title: London cultural hub showing African cinema open to all, contrary to 'segregation' claim
item.description: A new south London cultural hub showcasing Black and African cinema is open to all, contrary to an online narrative that it was endorsed by Mayor of London Sadiq Khan as a "segregated" space. Here are the key details:
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: A new south London cultural hub showcasing Black and African cinema is open to all, contrary to an online narrative that it was endorsed by Mayor of London Sadiq Khan as a "segregated" space. Here are the key details: Posts on Facebook shared news of the opening of EbonyLife Place London in early October, with captions claiming Khan had signed off on “‘Black Only’ spaces” and “Welcome to the #unitedkingdom where segregation and racism exists”. A spokesperson for EbonyLife Place London told Reuters by email that it was “absolutely open to everyone” and that its focus on Black and African films was about “the content we champion, not about restricting who can visit or enjoy our space.” A public relations agency working with the venue referred Reuters to an October 8 press release which cited founder Mo Abudu as saying: "Our cultural identity is clear, but our invitation is open to everyone.” Khan, who attended a ribbon-cutting ceremony for the venue on October 8, said in the same release that it was a “demonstration of how our capital celebrates our wonderful diversity, as we build a better London for everyone.” A Mayor of London spokesperson declined to comment further to Reuters. There is no credible reporting that Khan has approved or endorsed any “Black Only” spaces in London or that anyone has been denied entry to EbonyLife Place London based on race since its opening. Under the Equality Act 2010, race is a protected characteristic and “segregating” a person based on their race is prohibited direct discrimination. Verdict: Misleading. The venue is open to all, according to an EbonyLife Place London spokesperson, and there is no evidence the mayor endorsed a segregated space. This article was produced by the Reuters Fact Check team. Read more about our fact-checking work.

item.title: Bolsas europeas cierran su mejor semana desde junio, gracias a resultados empresariales
item.description: Las acciones europeas subieron el viernes, cerrando así su mejor semana desde finales de junio, en la que los sólidos resultados empresariales ayudaron a amortiguar el impacto de la caída generalizada de los valores tecnológicos a nivel mundial.

item.title: UK's Thames Water reaches deal with key Class B creditors on recapitalisation
item.description: Thames Water on Friday said it had reached an agreement with key Class B creditors on a proposed recapitalisation, securing support from holders of more than 60% of its junior Class B debt and advancing efforts to restructure Britain's biggest water utility.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Thames Water on Friday said it had reached an agreement with key Class B creditors on a proposed recapitalisation, securing support from holders of more than 60% of its junior Class B debt and advancing efforts to restructure Britain's biggest water utility. The proposal would see about £1 billion ($1.33 billion) of Class B debt written off, with those creditors receiving a roughly 5.9% recovery through equity and other rights in the restructured company in return. Thames Water said talks with the London & Valley Water consortium, Ofwat and other regulators on the proposed recapitalisation were ongoing, with no decision yet taken on whether to proceed with the consortium's proposal. ($1 = 0.7511 pounds)

item.title: US regional banks join bigger peers in signaling resilient economy as lending holds firm
item.description: A clutch of US regional banks reported strong third-quarter earnings this week, powered by robust loan demand from businesses, adding to signs that the economy remained resilient despite rising borrowing costs.
item.dc:creator: Pritam Biswas, Arasu Basil, Prakhar Srivastava
item.content:encoded: A clutch of US regional banks reported strong third-quarter earnings this week, powered by robust loan demand from businesses, adding to signs that the economy remained resilient despite rising borrowing costs. Earlier in the week, the biggest US banks such as JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) , Bank of America (BAC.N) , Wells Fargo (WFC.N) and Citigroup (C.N) also reported higher loan balances, even as weakness in the capital markets hit their investment banking revenue. People have accepted global uncertainty as the new normal and are pushing forward with operations, PNC Financial (PNC.N) CEO William Demchak said. "The clouds are as dark as they ever were, but the economy's still strong. People are investing into it," Demchak added. PNC led the regional banks' loan growth at 14.2% in the third quarter, followed by U.S. Bancorp (USB.N) at 8%, M&T Bank (MTB.N) at 5.5% and Citizens Financial (CFG.N) at 5.29%. The robust borrowing activity defied rising expectations that still-high inflation fueled by the Iran war and the Federal Reserve's September interest rate hike could chill corporate capital expenditures and dampen borrowing appetite. Top regional banking executives said loan pipelines remained strong and they had not seen any slowdown yet in demand. Citizens Financial said loan demand actually started to pick up in the last couple of weeks as the bank entered the fourth quarter. AI CATALYST? Banking executives said they were looking to understand how much of the loan growth was linked to the massive AI-related spending when pressed by analysts during post-earnings sessions. "This whole AI ecosystem build-out is kind of full-on. It's a very strong dynamic, and that kind of cascades into a lot of the supply ecosystem," Citizens Financial CEO Bruce Van Saun said. "Even with higher rates, the kind of desire to get the compute power in place, the players aren't really batting an eyelash," he added. PNC, which does not have a large data-center finance business, said there is an impact from the AI spending boom on tangential sectors like heavy equipment, transportation and energy. "If the capex broadly slows down related to AI, do we think, even though we don't lend directly to that, it would slower loan growth? Yes, I do," PNC's Demchak said. Some regional banks downplayed the AI dependency and emphasized broad-based commercial and industrial loan growth. U.S. Bancorp CFO John Stern said loan growth was robust even outside AI-adjacent sectors, highlighting areas like retail, food and beverage, and insurance.

item.title: Report: Eagles signing QB Joe Milton off Cowboys' practice squad
item.description: The suddenly short-handed Philadelphia Eagles are signing quarterback Joe Milton off the Dallas Cowboys' practice squad, NFL Network reported on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The suddenly short-handed Philadelphia Eagles are signing quarterback Joe Milton off the Dallas Cowboys' practice squad, NFL Network reported on Friday. Eagles starter Jalen Hurts will miss Sunday's game against the visiting Carolina Panthers after being diagnosed Thursday with a superficial blood clot in his calf. Fourth-year backup Tanner McKee, a sixth-round pick in 2023, will make just the third start of his career as the Eagles (2-3) try to snap their three-game losing streak. Under NFL rules, signing Milton off another team's practice squad requires him to be placed on the 53-man roster. Milton, 26, was a sixth-round pick by New England in 2024. He played one game for the Patriots that season, completing 22 of 29 passes for 241 yards and one touchdown and also rushing for a score in a Week 18 win against the Buffalo Bills. Milton appeared in four games off the Cowboys' bench in 2025, completing 15 of 24 passes for 183 yards with one TD and two interceptions. He has not played a snap in 2026. Philadelphia also has rookie Cole Payton on the QB depth chart. The Eagles released 38-year-old Andy Dalton last week after he threw an interception on his only pass attempt in the Week 3 loss at Chicago. --Field Level Media

item.title: Police seek answers after children killed in Oregon school shooting
item.description: Police in Bend, Oregon, were investigating on Friday why a 16-year-old boy shot dead three children and a teacher at the Silver Rail Elementary School, and how he got hold of the long gun used in his attack.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Police in Bend, Oregon, were investigating on Friday why a 16-year-old boy shot dead three children and a teacher at the Silver Rail Elementary School, and how he got hold of the long gun used in his attack. The latest deadly school shooting in the United States [USN:L1N461173 TEXT:"unfolded on Thursday afternoon"] when the teenager, who has not been publicly identified, shot through a locked door at the school in central Oregon, according to the Bend Police Department. The teenager killed three children aged 5, 8 and 11 and one teacher before he himself was shot dead by an armed bystander who had pursued him into the school, Police Chief Mike Krantz said at a Thursday evening press conference. Such shootings have become common in the US, with each one reviving debates over gun laws in a country where a right to "keep and bear Arms" is protected under the Constitution's Second Amendment. BYSTANDER INTERVENED The bystander has not been publicly identified by police, though recordings of 911 emergency calls released by authorities include a dispatcher saying he was possibly a father of a child at the school. Oregon Governor Tina Kotek said at the press conference that the bystander "heroically intervened to stop further loss of life." Beyond those killed, a 7-year-old student and a 54-year-old teacher were taken to hospital with critical injuries. It was not clear if the shooter had any prior connection to the school, which has about 450 students from kindergarten through the fifth grade, roughly ages 5 to 11, and 40 staff members. CBS News, citing unnamed law enforcement officials, reported that the attacker used a shotgun that his mother had purchased. Officials at the Bend Police Department did not immediately respond to questions on Friday. GUN LAW DEBATES Some of the deadliest school attacks in the US include those at Columbine High School in 1999, Sandy Hook Elementary School in 2012, Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in 2018 and Robb Elementary School in Uvalde, Texas, in 2022. Advocates for gun-owners' rights have argued for arming teachers as a means of defense. The Gun Owners of America advocacy group pointed to the armed bystander's intervention in Bend as evidence for their position. Residents of the small city of Bend were left grieving after the attack, which unfolded in minutes, with emergency responders receiving a call at 12:59 p.m. PDT (1959 GMT) from a person in a vehicle who reported being shot at multiple times by someone with a long gun, police said. In the minutes afterwards, dozens of calls were received saying the shooter had entered the school. Officers arrived at 1:02 p.m. and moments later an officer reported the shooter had been killed, police said. Officers entered and confirmed the teenager was dead.

item.title: Stars sign David Peron, 38, to one-year contract
item.description: The Dallas Stars signed forward David Perron to a one-year, $850,000 contract on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Dallas Stars signed forward David Perron to a one-year, $850,000 contract on Friday. Perron, 38, will be playing in his 20th NHL season with his eighth team. He totaled 28 points (13 goals, 15 assists) in 65 games last season split with the Ottawa Senators and Detroit Red Wings. "We are excited to welcome David and his family to the Stars organization," general manager Jim Nill said. "He brings a competitive mindset and a proven ability to perform in big moments. We believe his veteran leadership and skill set will be a valuable addition to our group as we continue to build toward our goal of winning a Stanley Cup." A Stanley Cup champion with the St. Louis Blues, Perron has totaled 812 points (332 goals, 480 assists) in 1,239 career games with the Blues, Edmonton Oilers, Pittsburgh Penguins, Anaheim Ducks, Vegas Golden Knights, Red Wings and Senators. He was selected by St. Louis with the 26th overall pick of the 2007 NHL Draft. --Field Level Media

item.title: Video de policías entre una multitud es antiguo y no tiene relación con protestas estudiantiles de 2026 en Francia
item.description: Un clip de un grupo de policías caminando junto a personas en Francia es de 2023 y no muestra que los uniformados se sumaran a los manifestantes, dijo la Gendarmería Nacional francesa ante publicaciones en redes sociales que vinculan las imágenes con las recientes protestas de estudiantes en el país.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Un clip de un grupo de policías caminando junto a personas en Francia es de 2023 y no muestra que los uniformados se sumaran a los manifestantes, dijo la Gendarmería Nacional francesa ante publicaciones en redes sociales que vinculan las imágenes con las recientes protestas de estudiantes en el país. A finales de septiembre estallaron [USN:L6N45V0FM TEXT:"protestas"] estudiantiles en París y otras ciudades por las [USN:L8N45S08G TEXT:"condiciones"] en las escuelas y la [USN:L1N45O03R TEXT:"financiación"] de la educación. “Policía renuncia para sumarse a las protestas en Francia” dice una inscripción sobre el clip de los agentes, algunos sin casco, que caminan junto al grupo de personas por la calle. Sin embargo, la versión más antigua vista por Reuters del video fue publicada en la red social X el 23 de marzo de 2023. Manifestantes salieron a la calle [USN:L8N35U4U1 TEXT:"en esa fecha"] en contra de un [USN:L8N3601A4 TEXT:"plan de pensiones"] del presidente Emmanuel Macron. Reuters geolocalizó el video en la capital francesa. Déborah Thiney-Masselin, portavoz de la Dirección General de la Policía Nacional de Francia, dijo a Reuters en un correo el 12 de octubre que el video fue grabado el 23 de marzo de 2023 y no muestra a agentes de policía, sino a miembros de la Gendarmería Nacional que supervisaban a un grupo de manifestantes para evitar posibles enfrentamientos. Agregó que ningún agente de policía ha renunciado tras las protestas de estudiantes de bachillerato. Marie Mongredien, portavoz de la Gendarmería Nacional de Francia, dijo a Reuters en un correo el 15 de octubre que la grabación corresponde a protestas contra la reforma de pensiones en 2023. El clip, de acuerdo con Mongredien, muestra una “fase de desescalada” en la que los gendarmes se quitan el casco para supervisar el final de la manifestación, lo cual es un “gesto habitual” para apaciguar la situación. “No debe interpretarse como señal de apoyo a los manifestantes”, agregó. VEREDICTO Erróneamente etiquetado. El video fue publicado en marzo de 2023 durante manifestaciones en Francia. item.title: CoreWeave's CEO sold nearly $1 billion of stock since IPO, filings show
item.description: CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator and entities linked to him have sold nearly $1 billion of stock, mostly under prearranged trading plans, since the AI cloud company's IPO in March last year, according to regulatory filings.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: CoreWeave (CRWV.O) CEO Michael Intrator and entities linked to him have sold nearly $1 billion of stock, mostly under prearranged trading plans, since the AI cloud company's IPO in March last year, according to regulatory filings. The sales began about two months after the stock hit a record high in June 2025. The shares have tumbled since and were on track to lose about 24% this week [USN:L4N4620ZT TEXT:"as investors worried about"] the Nvidia-backed company's heavy capital spending and the debt needed to fund it amid rising bets on interest-rate hikes. CoreWeave did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Here are some more details: The sales totaled more than 10 million shares, according to the filings. As of Thursday's close, CoreWeave had a valuation of $38.44 billion. The sales were made by Intrator and affiliated entities such as Omnadora Capital, where Intrator serves as managing member, and two trusts. Most of these sales, excluding roughly $40 million, were made under prearranged trading plans that allow executives to sell shares on a preset schedule, and do not necessarily reflect management's view of the business. The roughly $40 million that was not part of prearranged plans was sell-to-cover sales, where shares were sold on the market to pay taxes on vested stock. The selling occurred as CoreWeave rapidly expanded its data-center footprint and increased spending on Nvidia chips to meet demand for AI computing, while building a revenue backlog of [USN:L6N4590TM TEXT:"more than $129 billion"]. In August, the company raised its annual capital expenditure forecast to be between [USN:L4N4481ER TEXT:"$35 billion and $39 billion"].

item.title: India federation suspended by FEI amid governance crisis
item.description: The International Equestrian Federation (FEI) said on Friday it would suspend the Equestrian Federation of India (EFI) from December 1, barring Indian riders and officials from international competitions amid a prolonged governance crisis.
item.dc:creator: Karan Prashant Saxena
item.content:encoded: The International Equestrian Federation (FEI) said on Friday it would suspend the Equestrian Federation of India (EFI) from December 1, barring Indian riders and officials from international competitions amid a prolonged governance crisis. The suspension also prevents India from hosting FEI-sanctioned events and comes as the country seeks to establish itself as a major sporting destination while pursuing a bid for the 2036 Olympics. An FEI spokesperson told Reuters that the EFI would not be allowed to attend or be represented at meetings of FEI bodies during the suspension. "The situation will be reviewed once elections for the Executive Committee of the Equestrian Federation of India have been held and the results evaluated by the FEI," the spokesperson said. EFI members would also be barred from international events organised by the FEI or other national federations, whether competing under the Indian federation's flag or the FEI flag, the spokesperson added. Reuters has contacted the EFI for comment. The suspension follows years of governance disputes within the EFI. In February 2026, the Delhi High Court dissolved the federation's executive committee, whose elected tenure had expired in September 2023 but had continued in office under interim court orders to avoid disruption ahead of the Paris Olympics. The court directed the Indian Olympic Association (IOA) to appoint an ad-hoc committee to oversee the sport and conduct fresh elections under India's new National Sports Governance Act. The court ruled there was no justification for an elected body whose term had expired to continue in office and ordered a transition to a new administration under a restructured constitution. Those elections are yet to be held while uncertainty has continued under the ad-hoc committee. Earlier this year, the Delhi High Court, while upholding a contested selection decision, flagged a lack of clarity in the ad-hoc committee's athlete selection process and stressed the need for greater transparency and consistency in future selections. From December 1, Indian athletes, officials, trainers and horses will be barred from FEI-sanctioned competitions and events organised by other national federations. The suspension further isolates a sport that delivered India a team dressage gold medal at the Hangzhou Asian Games in 2023.

item.title: Putin diz que Rússia está criando “zona de segurança” inegociável na Ucrânia ao longo da fronteira
item.description: A Rússia está estabelecendo uma “zona de segurança” dentro da Ucrânia, ao longo da fronteira entre os dois países, o que não será passível de negociação em quaisquer conversações futuras com Kiev, afirmou o presidente Vladimir Putin nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Rússia está estabelecendo uma “zona de segurança” dentro da Ucrânia, ao longo da fronteira entre os dois países, o que não será passível de negociação em quaisquer conversações futuras com Kiev, afirmou o presidente Vladimir Putin nesta sexta-feira. Putin, vestindo uniforme militar e falando durante uma visita a um posto de comando, disse que a operação foi uma resposta à incursão da Ucrânia, em 2024-25, na região de Kursk, na Rússia. “As Forças Armadas russas receberam a missão não apenas de expulsar o inimigo de nosso território, mas também de estabelecer uma zona de segurança no território adjacente. Essa missão está sendo cumprida com sucesso”, disse ele em declarações transmitidas pela televisão. “Nosso objetivo é garantir a segurança absoluta das regiões fronteiriças da Rússia no futuro, e não pretendemos tornar isso um tema para possíveis negociações de paz com a Ucrânia.” O porta-voz do Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov, declarou que a zona de segurança planejada se estende por 660 km, dos quais 70% estão atualmente sob controle da Rússia.

item.title: Real Madrid exige la dimisión del presidente de LaLiga tras una comparación con la propaganda nazi
item.description: El Real Madrid exigió el viernes la dimisión del presidente de LaLiga española, Javier Tebas, después de que este comparara la retórica de la directiva del club con los métodos de propaganda utilizados por el Partido Nazi en Alemania.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Real Madrid exigió el viernes la dimisión del presidente de LaLiga española, Javier Tebas, después de que este comparara la retórica de la directiva del club con los métodos de propaganda utilizados por el Partido Nazi en Alemania. Tebas escribió el viernes en las redes sociales que "la dirección del Real Madrid dirige una orquesta de portaCOCES y Real Madrid TV lleva la voz cantante", haciendo un juego de palabras con "portavoz" y "coz", en respuesta a artículos de dos periodistas que afirmaron que él y LaLiga están actuando contra los intereses del club blanco. El presidente de LaLiga añadió que los autores de los artículos, del periódico El Debate, estaban amplificando un mensaje en nombre de la directiva del Real Madrid. Reuters ha pedido a El Debate que se pronuncie al respecto. La exigencia del Madrid de que Tebas dimita de inmediato agrava la disputa entre ambos. En septiembre, el club "merengue" pidió un nuevo presidente de LaLiga, después de que Tebas calificó sus quejas sobre las decisiones arbitrales de "cortina de humo" para ocultar sus deficiencias sobre el terreno de juego. El viernes, Tebas criticó la cobertura que Real Madrid TV hace del arbitraje en sus partidos. "Su partitura es siempre la misma: seleccionar las jugadas que interesan, repetir el agravio, alimentar la sospecha y señalar a los enemigos", escribió. "Ese método recuerda a mecanismos de propaganda que explotó Goebbels, ministro de Propaganda de la Alemania nazi", afirmó. "La comparación es con esas técnicas de propaganda, no con una ideología ni, por supuesto, con la afición madridista". El Madrid emitió un comunicado más tarde exigiendo que Tebas dimita de sus cargos como presidente de LaLiga y vicepresidente de la Real Federación Española de Fútbol. El comunicado calificó de "intolerable y de extraordinaria gravedad" que Tebas utilizara "una comparación con los métodos de propaganda del régimen nazi para desacreditar a nuestro club, a su dirección y a su televisión". "La conducta reiterada de Javier Tebas evidencia una falta de neutralidad, respeto e imparcialidad incompatible con sus responsabilidades institucionales", afirmó el Real Madrid. "Resulta inadmisible que aproveche incluso preguntas, informaciones u opiniones de periodistas ajenos al club para dirigir contra nosotros sus descalificaciones, atribuyéndonos actuaciones de terceros sobre las que no tenemos responsabilidad alguna", agregó. Tebas, de 64 años, elegido por los 42 clubes profesionales de las dos primeras divisiones españolas, es presidente de LaLiga desde 2013. En 2023 fue reelegido sin oposición hasta 2027. El comunicado del Real Madrid se produjo horas después de que LaLiga confirmara que es uno de los seis clubes que formarán parte del Comité Ejecutivo del campeonato esta temporada.

item.title: Trump move to restart direct US flights with Lebanon hits roadblock
item.description: The United Nations aviation agency has found Lebanon's main airport lacks valid certification, according to a report summary seen by Reuters, in a setback to US President Donald Trump's move to revive direct US-Beirut flights.
item.dc:creator: Allison Lampert, David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The United Nations aviation agency has found Lebanon's main airport lacks valid certification, according to a report summary seen by Reuters, in a setback to US President Donald Trump's move to revive direct US-Beirut flights. Trump made the announcement in July and signed an order last month for [USN:FWN43N0RD TEXT:"the US government"] to allow direct flights from the US to Lebanon, reversing a four-decade-long suspension after TWA Flight 847 was hijacked and forced to land in Beirut in 1985. While the US Federal Aviation Administration and the Transportation Security Administration would still need to conduct safety reviews before flights could resume, the Lebanese embassy in Washington called Trump's order "a significant first step toward restoring direct air service between Lebanon and the United States." However, the UN's International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) technical assistance mission to Lebanon in July identified shortcomings at Beirut-Rafic Hariri International Airport and in the aviation system. The findings, which two senior industry officials familiar with the matter expect to delay the resumption of service, complicate efforts to follow up on an order Trump signed after meeting Lebanese President Joseph Aoun. Washington has backed Aoun as it pushes for Iran-backed Hezbollah to be disarmed. The agency sent its internal report, made at the request of the Lebanese Civil Aviation Authority (LCAA), to Lebanon in September. AIRPORT LACKS EMERGENCY PLAN: ICAO Beirut airport's firefighting resources are equipped for single-aisle planes, but not twin-aisle jetliners used for long-haul flights, according to a summary of ICAO's report. The airport also lacks an emergency plan, and its conditional certification has expired, the report said. "This is a serious and time-critical matter that must be addressed immediately to preserve the airport's operational status," the summary said. The report also found the Lebanese regulator LCAA lacks qualified inspectors to oversee air traffic control licensing, and has no fully established, operational and independent aircraft accident investigation authority with clearly defined roles. Such concerns were flagged during a two-day workshop last month where officials from ICAO, Lebanon's government, the FAA and others discussed efforts to revive direct air service, according to the industry officials and an agenda of the meeting seen by Reuters. Lebanon's Minister of Public Works and Transport Fayez Rasamny said Lebanon was taking steps to address the concerns, with efforts to certify the airport starting on Saturday. The LCAA expects to issue conditional certification in the coming days. "Most of the issues highlighted in the report had already been identified by the LCAA, and corrective action had already been initiated," Rasamny said in a statement, adding that progress had been delayed by war. Israeli forces remain in southern Lebanon and have continued strikes despite a US-brokered framework agreement signed in June between Israel and Lebanon. Hezbollah, which was not party to the deal, has rejected it. The FAA and ICAO declined to comment. The US State Department advises Americans not to travel to Lebanon given safety concerns. It said the FAA advises caution for flights operating in Lebanese airspace due to heightened military activity in or around Syria, including the risks of errant long-range surface-to-air missiles originating from Syrian territory. MIDDLE EAST UNREST DISRUPTS AIR TRAVEL Foreign airlines have avoided large swathes of Middle East airspace because of missile and drone threats since US and Israeli strikes on Iran in February triggered regional hostilities, with an [USN:L6N4600LI TEXT:"airport"] in Saudi Arabia the latest site to come under attack. Lebanon and its national carrier have been praised domestically for maintaining air navigation services and flights, helping to prop up an economy that depends on tourism and remittances. Three US airline officials told Reuters on the condition of anonymity they do not think any American carriers would resume flights to Lebanon in the near term, citing security concerns. While there are no direct flights between Beirut and the United States, such service exists between Lebanon and some large European cities. The European Union Aviation Safety Agency said it was aware of the ICAO report and added that EU airlines must conduct their own assessment of an airport's safety and operational readiness before launching services.

item.title: Pant awaits fitness clearance as Bumrah returns for New Zealand tests
item.description: Wicketkeeper-batter Rishabh Pant was named in India's squad for next month's two-test series in New Zealand on Friday, subject to fitness clearance, while pace spearhead Jasprit Bumrah returned to the side.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Wicketkeeper-batter Rishabh Pant was named in India's squad for next month's two-test series in New Zealand on Friday, subject to fitness clearance, while pace spearhead Jasprit Bumrah returned to the side. The Shubman Gill-led test squad featured few surprises, with selectors retaining the core of the team, including all-rounder Ravindra Jadeja and opener Yashasvi Jaiswal. Pant was recently ruled out of the first two India A test matches against New Zealand with a left side strain but was included in the senior squad pending medical clearance. India begin the two-match test series in Wellington on November 19 before the second and final match in Christchurch from November 27. India also named squads for the accompanying five-match ODI series, with Gill set to captain the side in the opening three matches before Shreyas Iyer takes charge for the final two as they continue their preparations for next year's ODI World Cup in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia. Stalwarts Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma retained their places in the ODI squad, while Bumrah was selected only for the test leg of the tour. The ODI series starts in Auckland on November 4 and concludes in Mount Maunganui on November 15.
